name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.25.0 (released 2026-06-24) adds password reset via emailed magic links and reworks email verification to use durable single-use expiring links instead of in-memory 6-digit codes, plus a security fix to use crypto/rand for token generation. v2.24.0 (2026-06-04) introduced an opt-in in-memory ACL cache (auth-access-cache) for high-volume servers and fixed a critical case-insensitive ACL topic matching bug on SQLite. Recent releases also addressed several security issues including an SSRF fix in web push endpoint validation (v2.22.0) and a same-origin script execution vulnerability in the publish dialog (v2.23.0). Full release notes: https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL (client) — dual-licensed; check repository for exact terms
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2025/2026 with active community contributions
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — token-based auth, ACL per topic, access cache, email verification, and password reset

breaking_excerpts: Fix case-insensitive ACL topic matching on SQLite: an access control rule for 'secret' no longer also matches a request for 'SECRET' — behavior change that may affect existing ACL rules on SQLite-backed servers.
Email verification reworked from in-memory 6-digit codes to durable, single-use, expiring magic links — old verification flows no longer work.
X-Email: yes now sends to the primary verified email regardless of smtp-sender-verify setting and requires a verified address — previously was rejected unless verification was enabled.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a versatile notification library supporting dozens of services but is a client-side library rather than a standalone pub-sub server like ntfy.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with a limited free tier and no self-hosting capability.

alternatives.name: Ntopng Alerts / Grafana Alerting
alternatives.review: Grafana Alerting is powerful for metric-driven notifications with many integrations but is much heavier and complex compared to ntfy's minimal HTTP pub-sub approach.
